_comment: Baseline generated by scripts/audit-old-updater-imports.py --freeze; additively extended with the same audit engine over complete trees of every newly reachable shipped commit and the current tree. No baseline requirement was removed. Names an already-running `sci update` loads from the NEW tree after the checkout swap. Deleting a bare name bricks every release that loads it, mid-update, on a half-new tree. Regenerate after changing the update flow; never hand-trim. History enumeration is complete; static call-graph limits and unresolved_dynamic still require manual review.

history.coverage: All reachable commits inventoried; distinct selected path/blob versions analyzed. Commit evidence lists version witnesses, not every unchanged descendant.

incremental_extension.coverage: Complete trees for every newly reachable commit plus the baseline tree; union with the complete frozen baseline.

stats.completion_union: Preserved complete checked-in history and prior tree edges; unioned fresh current-tree audit.
